description: This file contains a Python class 'VertexAIRAGTransformation' that provides utilities for transforming data and constructing API requests for the Vertex AI RAG Engine. It includes methods for URL generation, chunking strategy conversion, request building, and authentication handling specifically tailored for Vertex AI's RAG API interactions.
